plugin.description: Utility for managing and filtering waystones and precursor/breach tablets in your stash.
stashutility.show_in_bg: Show Overlay When Game in Background
stashutility.show_in_bg_tooltip: If checked, the waystone highlights will remain visible even when the game window is in the background.
stashutility.enable_debug_tooltip: Enables advanced debugging options, interactive explorer, and hovered item inspector.
stashutility.debug.path_indices_tooltip: Comma-separated indices starting from the LeftPanel root. Edit manually or click through the explorer.
stashutility.debug.custom_root_tooltip: Leave empty to use gameUi.LeftPanel.Address as root.
stashutility.debug.root_null: Root address is null. (Game UI not loaded?)
stashutility.debug.path_failed: Path resolution failed at index step {0}.
stashutility.debug.hover_active: Hover me to highlight active node in game
stashutility.debug.hover_all_children: Hover me to highlight all children bounds
stashutility.debug.hover_hint: Hover over a waystone in your Stash Tab to inspect it.
stashutility.enable_waystone_manager_too: Enables or disables highlighting of waystones.
stashutility.min_tier_tooltip: Minimum Waystone Tier to highlight (Normal rarity is always ignored if Hide Normal Waystones is checked).
stashutility.filter_bad_mods_only_on_hig: Only Filter Bad Mods on Criteria-Meeting Waystones
stashutility.filter_bad_mods_tooltip: When checked, bad mod filtering is only applied to waystones that already meet the Tier and other active numerical criteria.
stashutility.filter_great_explicit_mods: Filter Great Min Explicit Mods Count
stashutility.filter_great_max_explicit_m: Filter Great Max Explicit Mods Count
stashutility.enable_tablet_manager_toolt: Enables or disables highlighting of precursor/breach tablets.
stashutility.min_good_mods_to_ignore_bad: Min Good Mods To Ignore Bad
If a tablet has this many good mods, it will ignore any bad mods and still be highlighted as Good/Great.
stashutility.enable_merchant_purchase_to: When checked, waystones and tablets in the active merchant purchase panel tab will be highlighted based on your criteria.
stashutility.tablet.god_tooltip: A God mod immediately flags the tablet as Good/Great, ignoring any Bad mods.
stashutility.affix_lang_tooltip: Language for waystone/tablet affix names. Use the same language as the game client.
